sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def bb(fr,col):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        if n['color']==col and min(rs)<63 and max(rs)<63:
            return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
res = action(['DOWN'])
B=bb(current_frame,'B'); S=bb(current_frame,'S'); c=bb(current_frame,'c')
print('after DOWN: B',B,'S',S,'c',c)
if B and B[0]==21 and S and S[2]==27:
    res = action(['DOWN']*7 + ['RIGHT'])
    B=bb(current_frame,'B'); S=bb(current_frame,'S'); c=bb(current_frame,'c'); Y=bb(current_frame,'Y')
    print('final: B',B,'S',S,'c',c,'Y',Y)
    print({k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
